text:
maria: Rolling out Apollo customer's LoRA (apollo-lora-v2) into staging quick-eval pack. Quick heads-up: int4 quant on our runtime is causing a subtle comma drop in currency output on a subset of examples. @chris @devon can you take a look?
chris: On it. Can you paste the eval run id and a small failing example?
maria: Eval run id: apollo-58. Command I ran: ```./rundev eval --pack apollo-quick-58 --model base-13b --adapter apollo-lora-v2 --quant int4 --batch 32``` Logs snippet: ```[resp] Expected: "Invoice total: $1,234.56"  Got: "Invoice total: $1234.56"```
devon: Huh. Does base-13b+int4 without the adapter reproduce?
maria: No — base 13b int4 (no adapter) returns comma as expected. Adapter on fp16 also returns expected. So it's adapter+int4 interaction.
akshat: Could be token alignment or a remapping causing comma to merge into preceding token. Does the LoRA include any embedding patches or added tokens?
maria: Customer pipeline adds a <AMT> token but the LoRA metadata shows no new tokens. Adapter config: no_vocab_changes, just weight deltas.
jess: I can run a quick tokenizer diff. Quick script: ```python -c 'from tokenizers import t; print(t.encode("1,234"), t.encode("1234"))'``` Will post results.
eval-bot: quick-eval apollo-58 finished: pass 66/100, fail 34. Top fail class: numeric formatting (17 cases). Fails CSV: https://ci.internal/reports/apollo-58/fails.csv
chris: :eyes: I'll repro locally with kv-cache padding and different chunking params. Maria, drop a minimal prompt that fails?
maria: Minimal prompt: "You are an invoice parser. Extract the invoice total." Input text: "Total due: $1,234.56"
devon: Also check the quant recipe. We're using block-wise int4 with per-channel scales; weight deltas from LoRA can amplify rounding in embedding->ffn paths.
akshat: Try running a quick experiment: fallback to int8 for the adapter inference path (same eval pack) — if that fixes it, we add a policy to prefer int8 when adapter present.
maria: I'll run int8 fallback now. If int8 fixes it we should add a targeted test in quick-eval to catch currency/tokenization diffs.
jess: I'll add 25 synthetic amount cases to the apollo quick-eval suite and open a PR against infra/tests.
chris: Proposed plan: 1) reproduce locally 2) try int8 fallback 3) inspect LoRA weight deltas for embedding layer + token alignments 4) add unit test to quick-eval. Assigning @devon to the weight-diff investigation.
devon: Taking the weight-diff task, will post a short diff and heatmap in ~2h.
maria: Thanks team :heart:
